description: A tranquil garden terrace at golden hour photographed at standing eye-level with a wide lens, capturing a relaxed outdoor seating vignette in an off-center thirds composition with the slender floor-mounted post unit centered in the middle ground. The patio floor is large-format limestone tiles in warm cream and grey. In the foreground left, an oversized rounded bean-bag style outdoor lounger in light grey weather-resistant fabric sits beside a low carved stone coffee table in travertine with an irregular organic edge. A wide sun umbrella in sand canvas extends from the upper right, partially shading the scene. A matte black slender tall floor-post unit stands at the mid-ground, its flat disc-form head emitting a soft warm flat glow directed downward, the light pooling at its base on the warm limestone paving. Behind it, a painted dark grey vertical-board garden shed with a gabled roof is flanked by lush lavender plants in full bloom on both sides, interspersed with ornamental grasses and tall hydrangea clusters in white. Large mature deciduous trees form a verdant backdrop silhouetted against a warm golden sunset sky with a low-horizon sun. Two large stone urns mark the garden perimeter. The mood is a relaxed, fragrant Provencal-inspired late afternoon.
